itens.descricao_en: Open-source Higgsfield on ComfyUI: 120 image, video, VFX and audio apps, every model open weights; runs on Modal or your own GPU
itens.readme:
# Freefield
Open-source Higgsfield on ComfyUI: every app is one folder, every model is open weights.
**[Watch the 2-minute demo video](https://youtu.be/N7mv2v3Txeo)**
Image, video, VFX and audio apps in a studio laid out like Higgsfield's, each one a ComfyUI workflow on open weights,
run on Modal, on a GPU rented by the hour (RunPod, Vast.ai) or on your own ComfyUI. Every example in the app is a real GPU run made by the lab, with its time and peak VRAM.
[Run it](#run-it) on [RunPod or Vast.ai](docs/cloud-gpus.md), on Modal or [on your own GPU](#on-your-own-gpu-without-modal) · [every app](#apps) with its model and VRAM · [add an app](#add-an-app) from any ComfyUI workflow ·
[every GPU run](docs/lab-runs.md) of the lab
    Explore.  Featured apps, the studios, and one lab example per app. 
    An app.  The form is drawn from the app's  app.json ; "Load this example" fills it with a lab run. 
    The Video menu.  46 apps grouped as in Higgsfield, and the open models behind them. 
    How it works.  Every model with its size and license, the VRAM per phase, and the commands to run the app. 
Freefield rebuilds Higgsfield's creative apps (image, video, VFX, audio) on top of ComfyUI and the Comfy SDK.
There is no per-app code. Each app is a folder in `apps/` with an `app.json` manifest and a ComfyUI workflow in API
format; the web UI, the runner, the model downloads, the VRAM map and the tests are all derived from those manifests.
```
browser ──▶ web/ + server/ (Node, Comfy SDK) ──

## Prompt Writing Skill
The `h3-image-prompt-writing` skill turns a short idea, a brief or a set of reference images into a
full MiniMax-H3-Image prompt, and can render it through the MiniMax API. It works in any agent that
reads a `SKILL.md`, such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Install it with the
[skills CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
```bash
npx skills add https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3-Image --skill h3-image-prompt-writing
```
Then ask your agent, for example:
```text
Use h3-image-prompt-writing to make a 3:4 poster of a night market in the rain,
titled "雨夜集市", and render it.
```
Rendering needs `MINIMAX_API_KEY`, and `MINIMAX_API_BASE=https://api.minimax.cn` on the China
platform. See [`skills/README.md`](skills/README.md) for details.

itens.descricao_en: Agent-native viral video studio: one-click replicate viral short videos, deconstruct video hooks and scripts into a Viral DNA report, and ship 10 costed variants. Skill + MCP + CLI. Apache-2.0.
itens.readme:
One-click replication for viral short videos. Deconstruct the script. Keep the structure. Ship 10 variants. 
    Quickstart   ·
    Case studies   ·
    Agent   ·
    How it works   ·
    Chinese  
**ViralForge is an agent-native studio for viral short videos.** Paste a link or a local file and
get a **Viral DNA report** that deconstructs the video script: the hook, shot-by-shot structure,
word anchors, beat grid, caption style, emotional curve and conversion logic. Replace the product
and script, and ViralForge rebuilds the winning structure **in one click** as an editable VFML
project. Then generate **10 costed variants** for A/B testing. Not another black-box MP4.
**Keywords:** viral video replication · video script deconstruction · one-click video remix ·
AI agent · MCP server · VFML · FFmpeg · UGC ads · content repurposing
English is the default documentation language. Chinese documentation lives in
[README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md). The v0.1 studio ships with Chinese-language demo fixtures; the
documentation and agent surfaces are English-first.
---
## Watch the demos
### Live-action reference → replica
Preserve the shot structure while replacing the person, product and setting. Both clips are about 10 seconds, 16:9, 720p.
    Original · brown tote · bedroom  Replica · grey-green tote · café  
Created manually with Jimeng Seedance 2.0 mini; the replica uses the original as a video reference. These clips illustrate the intended workflow, not an automated ViralForge mo

itens.descricao_en: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
itens.readme:
# article2media
**把一篇文章或一条视频，做成能直接发的小红书图文、长图、公众号排版和口播短视频，并且知道哪一版效果更好。**
开源 Claude Code / Codex Skills · 抓取 · 视频转文字 · 改写 · 翻译 · 长图 · 小红书卡片 · 公众号排版 · 竖屏口播视频 · 原文排版 · 白板论证 · 漫画 · 批量与发布数据
[ ](CHANGELOG.md)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](#依赖)
[ ](#设计原则)
[ ](#安装)
[ ](#安装)
**article2media** 是一组开源的 Claude Code / Codex Skill，同时也是一个 Claude Code 插件。它把一篇文章或一条视频做成可以直接发布的中文视觉内容。
它由 **10 个独立能力**组成：文章抓取、视频转文字、改写（总结）、全文翻译、长图、卡片、公众号排版、口播视频、白板论证、漫画。每个能力都是一个 skill，可以单独用（比如只把自己写的文章排成公众号，或者只把视频转成文字），也可以自由组合。总入口 `/article2media` 提供常用的一键组合，以及批量处理和发布数据记录。
- **输入**：
  - 文章：X（Twitter）长文、网页、微信公众号文章，或本地 Markdown；
  - 视频：抖音、YouTube、B 站链接，本地视频或音频，`.srt` / `.vtt` 字幕。视频先转成逐字稿文章。
- **产出**：
  - 手机上直接能读的长图、小红书 3:4 图文卡片、可直接粘贴的公众号排版；
  - 带本地 AI 配音和逐字字幕的竖屏口播视频；
  - 同一篇的几版封面，以及一页看完、金句图、问答卡这些更轻的形态；
  - 一字不改的原文长图、原文卡片和原文公众号排版；
  - 中文全文译文、白板论证图和黑白漫画。
- **验收**：每种产出都自动检查，不合格就报错。
- **发布**：发布清单、备选标题、发布数据记录与对比报告。
- **依赖**：只需要 Node.js 22 和 Chrome。
  示例：Dan Koe 的 X 长文《The most lucrative AI business to start in 2027》。每种产出各用了一套主题，口播视频用的是「资讯播报男声」。 看示例视频  ·  听 6 款音色   
---
## 为什么做这个
好文章在信息流里很难被读完。把它做成图文或视频，通常要截图、排版、配图、配音、剪辑，几个小时才做完一个平台，换个平台还得从头再来。
article2media 把这件事交给 AI。你给一个链接，流程分三步：
1. Claude 先把文章**读懂**：要总结时重组成一份和风格无关的结构化内容，要原文时一字不动，要翻译时逐段译出；
2. 脚本把它**渲染**成各平台需要的格式；
3. 交付前**自动验收**，有问题直接报错，不靠人眼去找。
并不是每次都需要总结。自己写的文章只想排成公众号，或者想把全文做成小红书卡片，就直接排版，不经过改写。所以每一步都做成了独立的能力，按需要拼起来。
## 核心特性
| | |
|---|---|
| **能力独立，组合自由** | 抓取、视频转文字、改写、翻译、长图、卡片、公众号、口播、白板、漫画各是一个 skill，只靠工作目录里的文件交接。总入口给出常用组合，也可以说"先翻译，再出原文卡片"这样自己组装。 |
| **原文、总结、翻译三条路** | 原文路径一字不改，逐块读回比对；总结路

Scenario Agent Skills

assets, and custom-trained models, for games, entertainment, and any creative vertical.

Engine, Unity, Godot, Roblox Studio), distilled from expert tutorials, conference talks, and
official documentation. They need the application, not the Scenario MCP server, and each family
folder's README records how it was built and how far it was verified.
Skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) format.

 Each one made with ReelMimic from a reference video and a one-line brief. Previews are silent, with the lyrics cropped out. 
## What is this?
Ever watched a video and thought "I want one in that style, but completely my own"?
Just drop it into ReelMimic. A file, a phone recording or a YouTube link all work. Then tell it what you want to make.
First it takes the reference apart: editing rhythm, shot lengths, transitions, framing, colors and camera moves. Then
it puts together a plan for you to check. You can chat right next to it, change settings or add assets, and start
when you're happy.
Once production starts, the work is split across several AI agents. Different parts of the video are made at the same
time, and every shot is handed to a different agent to check. If something's wrong it goes back to be fixe

itens.readme:
# 51 Free Video Effects for Claude
Free viral video effects for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, made inside Claude Code. Drop your video into Claude, type `/effects` and the name of an effect. That's the whole edit.
Made by [@vibha.in.progress](https://instagram.com/vibha.in.progress) 💛
> **Want the full studio?** These are the free starter versions from **[Hop Studio, my AI video editing studio inside Claude](https://vibha.is/ai-video-studio?source=effects-repo)**: 220+ video effects, 47 caption styles and 190+ sound effects, with sound design and hand-tuned timing. It runs on the Claude plan you already have.
## Install (one line)
Open the Terminal app (or the terminal inside Claude Code) and paste:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Vibha-Ramprakash/claude-video-effects ~/.claude/skills/effects
```
On Windows (PowerShell), use `$HOME\.claude\skills\effects` instead of `~/.claude/skills/effects`.
Then restart Claude Code. That's it.
> Not sure how? Open Claude Code and paste: **"Install the skill from github.com/Vibha-Ramprakash/claude-video-effects into ~/.claude/skills/effects"**. Claude will do it for you.
## Use it
1. Open Claude Code (the app or the terminal).
2. Drag your video into the chat.
3. Type the effect you want:
```
/effects orbit from 3 to 6 seconds
/effects spotlight when I say "kill the lights", with the word Claudit behind me
/effects comment-box at the end, typing CLAUDE
/effects glass-widgets for the first 3 seconds
```
